label: baseline
description: Gate baseline: work-package / skip-optional / robot + hot-resource probe, context_mode fresh. Recorded 2026-08-27 against workflows@11faffbd. Delivery is 21,677 characters above the previous recording of 1,357,843, which is the checkpoint presentation contract taking one home. What the corpus gained: when a gate is presented, what makes it soft, and which gate may never be soft are stated once, in the two workflow-engine operations that present and resolve a checkpoint, and the four workflow-level rules that each stated a version of it are gone. get_workflow rises 9,649 because that contract is in the operations bundle, and get_activity rises 8,566 because eager step-technique bundling delivers the same operations again in each activity that binds one — so roughly 4,000 characters of contract text costs about four times that across one walk. The deletions this change also makes — 88 blocking declarations, 16 auto-advance fields on gates that now wait for a person, and the four rule licences — sit in activity bodies and workflow rules rather than in the delivered bundle, so they do not offset it here. get_technique rises 3,619; get_resource falls 157.
